newsitem.title: USA: Fresenius Medical Care registers offering.
newsitem.headline: Fresenius Medical Care registers offering.

text.p: Fresenius Medical Care AG said it registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a five million preference share public offering and a public offering of $360 million trust preferred securities.

It said the preference shares will be offered in a combined U.S. and international offering and will be offered in the form of preference shares or American Depository Shares, each ADS representing a third of one preference share.
Fresenius Medical was formed in a series of transactions culminating in the combination of the global dialysis business of Fresenius AG and the global dialysis business of W.R. Grace.

CS First Boston; Dresdner Kleinwort Benson North America; UBS Securities and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell will underwrite the proposed U.S. offering of preference shares. Dresdner Kleinwort Benson; CS First Boston; Westdeutsche Landesbank Girozentrale; and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell are underwriters for the proposed international offering of preference shares.
Application will be made to list the ADSs on the New York Stock Exchange and the preference shares on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange, Fresenius said.

Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities; Bear, Stearns; CS First Boston; NationsBanc Capital Markets; Chase Securities; and Scotia Capital Markets are the underwriters for the trust preferred offering.
Net proceeds to the Company from both offerings will be used for refinancing of indebtedness and for general corporate purposes.
